debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (for troubleshooting only)

bind.description: IP address to bind the service to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0)

port.description: TCP port to listen on for HTTP(S) Git requests

repo_root.description: Path to the directory containing all Git repositories

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for secure Git operations

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required when ssl_enabled = true)

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required when ssl_enabled = true)

htpasswd_file.description: Path to the Apache htpasswd file (used when auth = 'htpasswd')

ldap_base.description: LDAP base DN to search for users (used when auth = 'ldap')

ldap_bind_dn.description: LDAP bind DN for performing directory searches (used when auth = 'ldap')

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind DN (leave blank if using SASL or anonymous bind; used when auth = 'ldap')

repos.description: List of repository access control rules (if omitted, default permissions apply)

read.description: List of allowed users/groups for read operations

write.description: List of allowed users/groups for write operations

admin.description: List of allowed users/groups with admin (push-to-create, delete, etc.) permissions

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

auto_detect_repos.description: Automatically discover and serve new repositories under repo_root

log_file.description: Path to log file (if empty, logs to stdout/stderr)
